RAN1#126의 공식 Agenda 목차입니다. 표의 숫자는 회의별 결정 수이며 상위 Agenda는 하위 Agenda를 합친 값입니다. 회의 간에는 같은 섹션 안의 같은 Agenda 제목끼리 이어 붙이고, 번호가 바뀐 경우 함께 표시합니다. RAN1#126에 없는 Agenda(삭제·통합·제목 변경)의 결정은 표에서 빠지고 맨 아래 '최신 회의에는 없는 Agenda'에 따로 모았습니다. 그래서 섹션 제목 옆의 '섹션 전체' 건수가 표의 합계보다 클 수 있습니다.

WA 확정 9.3.3 Other procedures

Confirm the following working assumption with following update. | Working assumption: RAN1#125 For one or multiple D2R resource set(s) provided by a periodic broadcast information A periodic broadcast information provides one or multiple “resource set configuration(s)” Each “resource set configuration” configures multiple resource sets that are periodic or a single resource set. At least the following configuration parameter can be different among the multiple “resource set configurations” Periodicity of resource set Time location of resource set Note: the content structure of the resource set configuration is same between the case of a single resource set and the case of multiple resource sets |Chair notes RAN1#126_eom1 · R1-2606199

후속 결정 후보 · 확인 필요 NR MIMO Phase 6 · 키워드 일치 75%

RAN1#125 FFS FFS: How to determine SRS resource set is spanned over two slots or confined within one slotChair notes RAN1#125_eom · R1-2605073 · [125-R20-MIMO]

RAN1#126 결정 Regarding whether an SRS resource set spans two slots or is confined within one slot, - If the offset values of all the SRS resources within the SRS resource set are k' = 0, - when all the SRS resources are entirely contained within the S slot, the SRS resource set is confined within one slot - when at least one SRS resource crosses a slot boundary, the SRS resource set spans two slots. - If the SRS resources within the SRS resource set have different k' values (both 0 and 1), the SRS resource set spans two slots. - If the offset values of all the SRS resources within the SRS resource set are k' = 1, the SRS resource set is confined within one slot.Chair notes RAN1#126_eom1 · R1-2606467 · [126-R20-MIMO]

후속 결정 후보 · 확인 필요 R2D signals, channels, waveform and procedures · 키워드 일치 67%

RAN1#125 FFS FFS: detail length of the time durationChair notes RAN1#125_eom · R1-2603693

RAN1#126 결정 For L1 R2D control information preceding periodic broadcast information (if supported), at least the following contents are included - TBS of subsequent periodic broadcast information payload - Transmission parameters for subsequent periodic broadcast information - FEC, repetition and chip duration (M value) - FFS: Whether separate or joint indication is needed - FFS: other contents, e.g., - [Presence of aperiodic CFO calibration signal after the data payload] - [(part of) Physical layer Reader ID] - [Message type] - [Time duration of CFO calibration signal] - FFS: Content structure and payload sizeChair notes RAN1#126_eom1 · R1-2605362

후속 결정 후보 · 확인 필요 R2D signals, channels, waveform and procedures · 키워드 일치 88%

RAN1#125 FFS FFS: whether the time duration includes time gap (if necessary) placed at the start and at the endChair notes RAN1#125_eom · R1-2603693

RAN1#126 결정 For the time duration of unmodulated sinusoid single tone CFO calibration signal transmission, at least 14 OFDM symbols duration including CP is selected - FFS other duration if necessary - Note: the time duration does not include time gap placed at the start and at the end if anyChair notes RAN1#126_eom1 · R1-2605364

RAN1#125 FFS FFS: What channel information UE reportsChair notes RAN1#125_eom · [125-R20-6GR-Transmission scheme for UL channels]

RAN1#126 결정 For codebook based PUSCH transmission for 6GR, study configurable codebook considering the following options and aspects: - Option 1. Downloadable codebook - NW determines a set of precoder(s)/matrices. - From NW, UE is configured with a set of precoder(s)/matrices. - After NW acquires UL CSI, an UL precoder within the set of precoder(s) is indicated by NW to UE. - Option 2. Uploadable codebook - UE determines a set of precoder(s) and reports to NW. - From NW, UE is configured with a set of precoder(s). - After NW acquires UL CSI, an UL precoder within the set of precoder(s) is indicated by NW to UE. - Whether to consider constant modulus property - Whether/how to indicate/obtain UE’s relevant information - How to construct hybrid approach between fixed codebook and configurable codebook - Memory burden / implementation complexity for UE/NW side - Applicable scenario/use case (e.g., applicable number of antenna ports) - How to consider PAPR increase and UE power constraintChair notes RAN1#126_eom1 · R1-2605832 · [126-R20-6GR-Transmission scheme for UL channels]

RAN1#125 FFS FFS on other basis, e.g., for near field, basis combined from DFT beams/port selection, and non-orthogonal DFT basisChair notes RAN1#125_eom · [125-R20-6GR-Aspects of DL based CSI acquisition]

RAN1#126 결정 For the 6GR codebook design for CSI report, study a W1W2 only structure for the low-resolution scheme with the following considerations at least for RI=1-4: - W1-structure - SD basis - NR oversampled 2D-DFT basis is a baseline - FFS on other basis, e.g., basis constructed from combined 2D DFT beams - FFS on alphabet set for combination coefficients for the basis constructed from combined 2D DFT beams - SD basis selection - eType-I Scheme-B like unrestricted orthogonal DFT beam selection in 2D direction is a baseline - FFS on orthogonal basis selection in at least 1D direction, or non-orthogonal basis selection - Layer-specific/layer-group-specific SD basis selection - FFS on basis-to-layer (layer-group) mapping, e.g., ordering or no ordering - FFS on the maximum number of SD basis vector selection - W2-structure - Layer-specific/layer-group-specific inter-polarization co-phase selection - FFS: inter-polarization amplitude - Alphabet set for inter-polarization co-phase: BPSK, QPSK - FFS: details for each rank - FFS: for WB, whether to consider or not 8-PSK in addition to BPSK and QPSK - FFS on RI>4 - Strive for having a unified codebook scheme for all supported ranks by 6G - FFS: details on whether/how to accommodate passive array with smaller number of ports - Note: UE implementation complexity is to be considered in the design of SD-basis and co-phasing selection, including the number of candidate combinations and the associated search complexity. - Note: CBSR discussion will be discussed separately - Note: For discussion of low resolution scheme, eType-1 Scheme-A and eType-II with L=1 are precludedChair notes RAN1#126_eom1 · [126-R20-6GR-Aspects of DL based CSI acquisition]

RAN1#125 FFS FFS: maximum number of DCI container sizes for a UEChair notes RAN1#125_eom · R1-2603880 · [125-R20-6GR-DL control channel and scheduling]

RAN1#126 결정 Study at least the following mechanisms for DCI Container size determination (at least for RRC connected state), with the details as below: - For Alt 1: - the container size(s) is implicitly derived from the RRC configuration, - E.g., the size for a given DCI container is the maximum possible size based on RRC configurations for the applicable functionalities. - For Alt 2: - the container size(s) are explicitly signalled by the network via RRC - For Alt 3’: - DCI container size(s) is not dependent on UE-specific RRC configuration - This is e.g., cell-specific DCI and random access procedure DCI in common search space. Details FFS. - FFS: Padding/reservation - FFS: need for truncation - FFS: need for size determination during bandwidth adaptation. - Regarding UE’s DCI monitoring size budget, for a single carrier operation, - FFS: the maximum number of container sizes for a UE to monitor (e.g., for BD purpose) is Xmax. - FFS: Whether the maximum number of container sizes for a UE to monitor (e.g., for BD purpose) for UE’s RNTI (e.g., C-RNTI) is Ymax. - FFS: whether the limitation is per slot or across slots - FFS: for multi-carrier cases - FFS minimum container size. - FFS maximum container size. - FFS maximum number of container sizes for two stage DCI - Note: Using a combination of the above alternatives for different use cases is not precludedChair notes RAN1#126_eom1 · R1-2606048 · [126-R20-6GR-DL control channel and scheduling]
